states.NOT_RUN: No accepted/attempted current analysis and not eligible or unconfigured
states.READY: Fresh valid configured current snapshot, no attempted analysis
states.RUNNING: Active process execution for this snapshot
states.PARTIAL: At least one but fewer than three accepted current outputs
states.FAILED: Durable attempted/interrupted run with no accepted current outputs

legacy_status: Kept for compatibility; team_status is canonical
restart: Recover valid cache and durable failed/interrupted role records, never silently reset failed to ready
freshness: Historical COMPLETE/PARTIAL/FAILED preserved; eligible false and operational STALE when aged
cache_publication: Grounding validation, durable ledger, then usable cache/publish
cancellation: Internal cancellation stops later roles/attempts; browser abort cannot cancel an in-flight paid SDK request
